content.title: School Closings and Delays
content.text: Skip to contentSafety and SecurityClosings and DelaysWe understand that the decision to close or delay schools impacts families. We strive to make these decisions in a timely and transparent manner, prioritizing the safety of our students and staff. Please visit our web event calendar to review scheduled closings.When will I be notified of a school closing or delay? How will I be notified of a school closing or delay?How does a closure or delay affect before and after-school programs?📞📱📧Chesapeake Public Schools uses our Parent Alert System to provide information and updates regarding emergency situations and changes to school operations. Our primary goal is to provide timely awareness; therefore, initial notifications may not include many details, as the situation is developing and accurate information is still being gathered. Additional updates will be sent as more information becomes available.Emergency InformationTwo-Hour DelayIn the event of a two-hour delay, all Chesapeake Schools will begin two hours later than the normal start time (students and staff should arrive two hours after the posted regular start time for their school). 🍽Breakfast and lunch will be served using an amended schedule.Additionally, the specialized programs listed below will operate under the following conditions:Program-Specific Schedules (Two-Hour Delay)School ClosingEarly ClosingsSchool ClosingsPrepare for a School Closing or DelayFor Students and FamiliesUpdate Contact InformationDownload our CPSchoolsVA AppBe Ready For Remote LearningFor StaffStaff Expectations & PreparednessStaff Communication & Alert SystemsLeave & Emergency Absence ProceduresHow do we decide to close or delay school?The decision to close or delay school is made by the Superintendent and administrative officers. When bad weather is in the forecast, central office administrators will consult with local police, city emergency operations staff and monitor various sources, including: Meteorological DataRoad ConditionsInfrastructure StatusOther Extenuating CircumstancesContactChesapeake Public SchoolsSchool Administration Building1421 Kristina Way,Chesapeake, VA, 23320757-547-0153Contact Us on Let's Talk
